notes.title: 1.0更新优化一览
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36539089/20d59f53a3f4e3a27f967d610bbd0385a954d3fc.png[/img]
发售以来，我们收到了大家的许多反馈建议，比如提到人物角色太多，记起来复杂，我们正在进行Tips系统的制作；比如部分文本问题，我们已经对全文本精校了一版；界面UI显示不明确，我们已经制作了一版新界面UI...
非常感谢大家的反馈建议，我们已安排上。
1.0更新说明：
1.精校全文本。
2.新版界面UI实装。
3.调整郭风笑配音音量默认为静音，若有需要，可以在“设置——音量设置”中单独打开。
4.修复了夏让和夏妙对话部分CG顺序错误的问题。
5.修复李曼成和张角对话部分局部立绘过大的问题。
6.修复了曹植和关羽两人立绘图层错误的问题。
7.Tips功能实装。（待定）

后续待更新的计划
1.全语音后期调整补充，逐句修整爆音、前后音量不匹配、语调等问题（进度15%）。
2.Tips系统装载。（待定）


各位小伙伴在体验游戏的过程中有任何建议或者反馈，都可以在社区或者官方交流群：121787975中反馈，我们会第一时间解决您的问题。
最后，祝各位五一节快乐！

notes.title: Thanks for encouragement and encouragement, we will immediately update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36539089/d4968e0f316519412f4f14663ed51d84a28491cb.png[/img]
"Miss Meng De and the Self Explosive Youth" has been released for 3 days, and we have received many concerns, encouragement, and criticism from everyone. We all humbly accept it.

At the same time, we have sorted out the prominent issues in the feedback and will update and optimize them within a week (as much as possible within 3 days) for the issues that have a significant impact!

Just like we once wrote in the article 'Written Before Release'——

What I want to do is just send this game to the world, in order to give an explanation to all members of the project team over the past three years, and most importantly, to myself.

I am fortunate to have obtained it, but I have lost it.

I only hope to receive an objective and fair evaluation from everyone, which is sufficient for us.

Without losing its integrity, without obscuring its clarity. “

——Thank you and pay tribute to every person who has had a serious gaming experience and left valuable feedback

==================(Below is the Q&A&Optimization direction)======================

Q1: The plot is only half done, will there be another one? When is it expected to depart?

A: It is a helpless move to only release half of the plot. As early as two years ago, 80% of the entire plot had already been completed. However, at that time, both the release and we were waiting for the version number, so we were unable to list it. Therefore, the entire cash flow was stuck. If we had listed it two years earlier, the current situation might have been completely different.

In addition, whether we can make a comeback now has no impact on the next installment, and the investment in the lower part of the current plan will be higher than that in the upper part. Through this release, we have gained a lot of practical experience and met many new partners, which will give us more confidence in the development process of the lower part. If we are optimistic, the second half of the year will be available to everyone in December or February next year. Please pay more attention to the official account, Stay up-to-date with new news and artwork content.



Q2: There are some illogical settings in the plot, such as the presence of tobacco in the Three Kingdoms period and the university regulations being similar to high school. What is the reason for this setting?

A: According to official records, tobacco first appeared during the Wanli period of the Ming Dynasty, but some unofficial historians believe that there were plants similar to tobacco during the Han Dynasty. The tobacco gun in this work is only used as a transitional element and is not the theme.

Regarding the issue of university regulations, as the story was originally set during the protagonist's high school years, the background was converted to university due to the age limit of the characters in the version number submission at that time. As a result, there was no mobile terminal available, and this part of the work became redundant.



Q3: There were many text errors and dubbing errors in the early stage, will you handle them?

A: Yes, this part of the proofreading work was indeed not done well. At that time, in order to save money, I did not find a professional proofreading, and later on, my older brother did not have relevant experience. In addition, I myself belong to a relatively rough style, so some details seem unsatisfactory. If this has caused a negative impact on everyone, I sincerely apologize. In addition, the new version of proofreading will be installed within a week. (Currently, the proofreading progress is 30%)

The main reason for dubbing errors is that many lines are not suitable for colloquial expression, so I authorize all CV teachers to adjust the copy at their discretion without changing the original meaning of the lines. However, some dubbing errors are indeed true and will be corrected in the future.



Q4: Will some dubbing voices have inconsistent sound quality and the phenomenon of fried wheat be dealt with?

A: Because there is no condition to dub in the recording studio, the recording environment may be worse. The lower part will try to organize everyone to record in the recording studio, so that the dubbing can have better quality.

If conditions permit, we will re record the dubbing of the first part in the recording studio.

In addition, there has been feedback from players that the sense of immersion in the non first perspective is low, and they hope to default to the protagonist's silence. This is indeed my negligence, and I have temporarily wronged Teacher Anye. However, I believe that Teacher Anye has already provided a good configuration. If you want the protagonist's voice, you can actively open it in the CV settings interface.



Q5: Some of the character dubbing currently has a stiff reading, will the character CV be re selected in the lower half?

A: I will keep all the voiceover CVs in this game, unless the teachers themselves are unwilling to continue. I don't think everyone's voiceover is not good. The more problem is on my side, I haven't set up the lines of each character properly, which leads to them not being able to integrate the characters well during voiceover. Additionally, the poor recording conditions are also one of the main reasons. In the next game, I will focus on this aspect and strive to provide everyone with a better gaming experience.



Q6: "Yue in" or "le in"?

A: It's Yue entering. We had feedback from players before the launch and also noticed the issue. However, the dubbing work was quite tight as it was approaching the launch, and most of the dubbing work had already been completed, so we were unable to modify it. We will do so as soon as possible.



Q7: What is the reason why some CG games have different artistic styles?

A: The art style used in this game is semi thick coating, and the first half is relatively stable because at that time, most of the work was completed independently by the main beauty pipo, and a few were outsourced, ensuring quality. In the middle and later stages, due to the addition of other new painters, the painting style was somewhat unstable, and occasional painting crashes occurred, resulting in a relatively inconsistent artistic style in the end.



Q8: Cao Cao is a woman, how were Cao Pi and Cao Zhi born?

A: Cao Pi and Cao Zhi were created by Meng De using the celestial astrolabe The specific situation will be explained in detail in the second half, so there will be no spoilers here.



Q9: There are differences in the styles of different characters in the game. Is it because the character design ideas are different?

A: In fact, there is no fixed idea. Our idea is to paint well first. As for the size of the chest that is roast about, it is completely an accident.



Q10: Will there be new characters appearing in the second half of the plot? Like Kong Ming and Uncle Liu?

A: There may be, but it won't be the main character. In the lower part, Miss Meng and Feng Xiao will mainly fight against Cao Pi. If the Shu and Wu forces make an official appearance, they will be mainly discussed in other games in the series. Of course, at that time, they will be the main perspective, and Miss Meng and Feng Xiao will still serve as the gatekeepers.



Q11: Are all the characters and plot settings in the game imaginative or based on evidence? Are you considering creating a detailed version of the character and plot settings?

A: It will be released, and recently I have noticed that there may be confusion among many settings. I plan to add a small tip function to facilitate everyone's understanding of the plot.



Q12: Did the appearance of team leader and Xiao Chen in the game undermine the sense of immersion?

A: Regarding Xiao Chen and the team leader, my intention is that apart from the halo of generals, those Three Kingdoms generals are also considered ordinary people, and we are also ordinary people, so they are not unreachable; The original intention of this setting is to provide everyone with a space for substitution, so they do not have a CV, and unexpectedly, everyone understood it to have other meanings.

Some friends have also reported that Xiao Chen and Xu Chu may have some unnatural feelings and lack a natural feeling. I will focus on this issue in the lower part and redesign their relationship lines.



Q13: In what form will the second half of the plot of 'Mende' be released? Is there a fee or not?

A: It should be in the form of DLC, which is currently under discussion and confirmation. After confirmation, we will inform everyone; Fees should also be charged, after all, the production cost is still quite high, but the price is definitely based on sincerity. Please rest assured in this regard.
